title: Sample-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Medical Image-to-Image Translation
abstract: arXiv:2508.00766v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image-to-image translation has emerged as a powerful technique in medical imaging, enabling tasks such as image denoising and cross-modality conversion. However, it suffers from limitations in handling out-of-distribution samples without causing performance degradation. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) framework that dynamically adjusts the translation process based on the characteristics of each test sample. Our method introduces a Reconstruction Module to quantify the domain shift and a Dynamic Adaptation Block that selectively modifies the internal features of a pretrained translation model to mitigate the shift without compromising the performance on in-distribution samples that do not require adaptation. We evaluate our approach on two medical image-to-image translation tasks: low-dose CT denoising and T1 to T2 MRI translation, showing consistent improvements over both the baseline

translated_title: 面向医学图像到图像转换的样本感知测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 图像到图像转换已成为医学成像中的一项强大技术，能够实现图像去噪和跨模态转换等任务。然而，该方法在处理分布外样本时存在局限性，容易导致性能下降。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的测试时自适应框架，该框架能够根据每个测试样本的特性动态调整转换过程。我们的方法引入了一个重构模块来量化域偏移，以及一个动态自适应块，它选择性地修改预训练转换模型的内部特征以减轻偏移，同时不会损害无需自适应的分布内样本的性能。我们在两个医学图像到图像转换任务上评估了我们的方法：低剂量CT去噪和T1到T2的MRI转换，结果显示相比基线方法取得了一致的改进。
tldr: 提出了一种样本感知的测试时自适应框架，通过重构模块量化域偏移，并利用动态自适应块选择性调整预训练模型的内部特征，在低剂量CT去噪和MRI跨模态转换任务中有效处理分布外样本，同时不损害分布内样本的性能。
en_tdlr: A sample-aware test-time adaptation framework is proposed that quantifies domain shift via a reconstruction module and selectively adapts a pretrained translation model's internal features with a dynamic adaptation block, improving medical image-to-image translation on out-of-distribution samples without degrading in-distribution performance.
